description: PAYWALLED. Is a token's volume real demand? Round-trip analysis of the last 24h: how much volume came from wallets buying and selling the same token back and forth (wash trading, arbitrage or market making) versus one-way trades, with the top round-trippers and pool liquidity. Returns x402 payment instructions for GET /api/x402/volume-check/{mint} ($0.004).
name: volume_check
